Sign-off STA on the cb2 odbs: FF misses are output ports (o_data/o_addr/o_tag/o_mask: flop->pin 52 ps vs sender min L+75 ps; route hold repair left -1.5..-4.9) and, on b8, the cloned o_v pin flop whose clock leaf (clkbuf_leaf_43, 81.6 ps vs 36-44 ps typical) sits +44 ps late (i_row hold -14.6, b24 setup -3.1 on the same class). cb3, structural on both sides: (1) every flop-driven output gets a FIRM BUF->HB1->BUF hold stage at its pin (hold_pad.out_cell HB1, ~38 ps FF fixed sender-min delay; inputs keep HB2); (2) clock tree sink clustering 16 sinks / 24 um / 20 um buffer spacing: CTS gate leaf spread 54 -> 29 ps (TT insertion 211 ps <= 300); (3) io_budget 0.55/0.55 (launch with pad est. <= ~200 <= 220, capture cone ~150 <= 190 at the native audit).
